day.headline: A Snake day — Ox and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Ox and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the pen about to run out
signs.message: That pen's nearly dead. Write the thing before it quits.

reasons: Snake's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Raise the chair before you sit. Thirty seconds, different day.

reasons: Monkey pairs with Snake — a harmonious day
signs.message: Ask his name today. You've nodded at that dog for months.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a photo album not opened since
signs.message: Pull that album out in daylight. Show someone a good one.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Fill up now, not at empty. Grab a snack, keep moving.

reasons: Rooster and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Mark the wall where it goes. That's today's whole shelf project.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: It ate your afternoon. Drop one task, don't rebuild the day.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a decision you would take back
signs.message: Nothing to undo there. Let it sharpen the next call, quietly.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Wear the mismatched pair or none. Not a fussing morning.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: tapping a doorframe on the way out
signs.message: Tap the wood, leave the rest of today unplanned.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Cook it by feel again tonight. Measuring cups stay away.

reasons: Pig opposes Snake — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: the button held by one thread
signs.message: One thread's still doing its job. Don't test it today.
